Climate Policy Update

By Mira Chen, May 12, 2026

The city council approved a climate policy package that accelerates electric buses, depot chargers, and neighborhood air-quality sensors.

Officials said the first 120 electric buses will enter service before winter, with priority routes near schools and hospitals.

The package also funds grid upgrades for transit depots so the fleet can charge overnight without new diesel backup generators.
